title: Betterhelp Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=betterhelp:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in betterhelp metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme betterhelp metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the unusually high or low value moments in your betterhelp metric2 (2) history.
